answer_1.quote: RAINIER is a sequence-to-sequence language model, p_K (k|q; θ), and we expect it to generate knowledge statements (k's) in response to the given question (q).
answer_1.outputs: natural language knowledge statements (sentences) used to prompt QA models

answer_4.quote: We asked three NLP experts to annotate the selected knowledge ( §2.3) for up to 100 questions per dataset among the validation sets of 8 benchmarks (5 seen, 3 unseen; see Figure ).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluated quality aspects such as relevance, factuality, helpfulness, and also domain, relation, and syntactic properties of each knowledge statement.
